## Updates stay on 1.x

- STL Editor 2.0 is on its way as a separate download. From this version on, **Check for Updates** and **Update now** only ever offer newer 1.x versions, so your installed copy is never swapped for 2.0 by surprise.
- When 2.0 is out you choose when to try it. It sits beside 1.x and does not replace it.

Nothing else changed: the tools and your projects work exactly as in 1.17.0.
